continuum_gate_policy: Finite-K independent calibration is the main numerical claim. Separately frozen directed metric-forcing and complete local/baseline omitted-band bounds may enclose removed-cutoff differences; their high-derivative envelopes are deliberately conservative and cannot certify precise continuum pressure or a sign. Quadrature/refinement/arithmetic remain empirical estimates, and no total-error enclosure or universal absolute continuum precision goal is claimed.

controls.must_retain: actual failures and their original sources
controls.scope: Registered source/provenance/format guards and saved-mode operator/contact mutations; no alternate physical states or twenty additional physical runs

followup.changed_numerical_method: Continuum integration only; plus explicit serialization of equivalent empirical memory-error allowances. Finite-K physical values and SciPy algorithm unchanged.

independent.history: direct q, density, pressure and physical baseline cutoff values at every time step; independent composite Simpson conservation ledger

memory_followup.changed_method: Archive I/O and array lifetime only; chunked file hashing. All physical producer computations, grids, numerical gates and resource limits remain unchanged.
memory_followup.expectation_scope: Saved prior producer declaration exceeds unchanged gate; no raw auditor ran in that partial round. Third run seeks complete data and exact expected-failure classification, not relaxed acceptance.

normalization.Q0: physical finite-K baseline variance; no epsilon division
normalization.current: a0^2 delta_j/epsilon = q; b=1,r=2 and phi fixed
normalization.p0: physical finite-K baseline pressure; no epsilon division
normalization.rho0: physical finite-K baseline density; no epsilon division

stop_rules: No new metric source samples, response quadratures, physical modes or response values before all numerical inputs, code and gates are publicly committed and the remote tree is verified.
Preserve every run and failure without overwriting; no gate, grid, model, cutoff or budget tuning after results.
Every contingent new physical experiment requires a separate prior public registration.
Pure coordinate controls need both lapse and scale variations or an explicit coordinate pullback; a compact conformal h alone is not pure gauge.
Do not mark the full metric/actual-root/bulk/state automation prerequisite PASS from this special-point calibration.

ward_acceptance.coarse_endpoints: 36 reconstructed and reported without endpoint gate
ward_acceptance.definition: Rprime - L*R + 3L*P + 3*hprime*a0^4*(rho0K+p0K)=0 at fixed physical x and fixed comoving cutoff
